title: Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech: Asian Dining, Padel Tournament and Kids Camp This Summer
image_query: luxury resort swimming pool palm trees
body:
The Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech launches its summer 2026 programme: Asian outdoor dining Thursdays-Saturdays in the tropical garden with DJ from 8 PM; an open padel tournament in August (entry 150 MAD); a children's summer camp weekdays for ages 5-14; and spa deals up to 30% off for day-pass guests Monday-Thursday.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech and Fairmont Royal Palm Marrakech.
